CHRISTMAS EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Yule Cat!!
Finally you're here.\nThis is the final bastion to protect my life...
I wanna keep living this peaceful life.\nI won't let you power this establishment!
W-waittt!\nI just need Xmas energy to flow!
I don't wanna hear any excuses!
We can't seem to persuade it.\nFine then, I guess we need to do it the hard way!\nGo take it down, now!
Y-yesss! We won!
I guess now Xmas energy can be transmitted.\nBut, why would you do such a thing?
I only came here because I wanted to be in a quiet\nplace.
Was the energy transmission process making a lot\nof noise? But wait, this place was operating too\nlast Xmas, wasn't it?
I have no problem with this place operating.\nThe problem is you and your friends!
M-me and my friends?\nWhat did we do wrong?
Everything, you guys come suddenly in groups and\nmake so much noise...! And you guys like to pose\nand shout at random stuff too!
It's annoying! It was so infuriating!!\nThat's why I thought you guys would leave if this\nestablishment stops operating!
But, this establishment belongs to my clan in the\nfirst place. You can actually stay here if you\nbehave properly.
Really? I apologize for being disrespectful.\nI'll be fine as long as those reindeer stop\nshouting and making weird poses too.
I got it. I guess we were being a little\noverexcited. We'll try to control ourselves from\nnow on.
Well, that means one problem is solved, right?
Yeah, I guess so.\nNow we only need to put the Holy Stones back to\ntheir place.
Holy Stones? What are they? Are they valuable?
The amount and flow direction of Xmas energy is\nbeing controlled in this pavilion with 10 Holy\nStones. Where are they now? Give them back, c'mon!
Hm? Wait, I never know how this establishment is\nbeing powered or how to stop it. It stopped on its\nown and that's why I occupied this place...
Uh, well, what about that thing?
Oh! There it is!\nThat's a Holy Stone!!
W-what are you doing?!
I-I didn't do anything!\nYou were the one who came at me..
C-come to think of it, I've seen that creature in\nvarious places.
Without the Holy Stones, we can't operate the\nfacility here. I'm sure they're somewhere in this\npavilion, so please find them!
Yes, please help us!
Hm...but I don't remember seeing anything like the\nHoly Stone in here. You know I've a good eye for\ntreasure and rare stuff, I'd have noticed them...
You're right. I haven't seen any either...
Yule Cat! Is there any chance that your minions\nare playing and hiding the Holy Stone somewhere\njust like the creature we saw earlier?
What? Um, er...\nI can't say no for sure because I don't see\nthem...
Anyhow, without the Holy Stones, Xmas energy can't\nbe transmitted, right? Then, the only way is to\ncollect as many as needed.
By the way, what about you, Shawle?\nYou're not gonna help?
I, I don't like that thing...L-let me be clear\nhere! I have no obligation to help to that extent!\nJust go and collect the stones immediately!
Alright, alright!\nWe'll go then.
Thanks, I'm counting on you guys!
It's not enough yet.\nPlease, do whatever it takes to collect them so\nthat Xmas energy can be transmitted!
Thank you!\nNow we'll be able to transmit the Xmas energy!
By the way, you remember the rewards you promised\nus, do you?
Thanks!\nIt's something from here though, here you go!
Okay, now we should be able to celebrate Xmas!\nLet's go, Dunder!
You can count on me, my lady!
Tee-hee, hahahahaha...! That means Xmas will begin\nagain, right? Well, Velly, it's time for the\nshowdown between you and me...
Oh yeah, Dunder, have you managed to contact my\nclan?
Yes, 200 friends of mine seem to be rushing over\nto help.
Whoaaat?!\n200 of those creatures?
If that's the case, I think we're gonna make even\nif we only start now! Let's hurry!
Oh well, we've got what we want, shall we just go\nhome?
Sigh. Alright then, since it hasn't been easy for\nthis to happen, I kinda feel bad if I interrupt.
Excuse me, Mr. Shawle.\nThere's something I wanna ask you.
Hm? What do you want?
Um, it's about that creature.
Is it actually a cat or not?\nOr is it a different animal or monster?\nDoes it stay here all the time?
I'm not sure how to answer your question...\nI think if it'll be fine if we just leave it\nalone.
Okay.\nWell, at least the reindeer are gone.\nI guess it's good for now.
